source_of_truth: Google Drive canonical seven-document instruction set

topview_scene_intake.rule: Scene ID identifies the creative scene; each Topview task ID is one render attempt. Re-running an existing scene appends an attempt, preserves prior attempt history, and returns the existing Scene ID to canonical slow whenever a new attempt is init/queued/running/processing. Multiple simultaneous attempts keep one canonical slow Scene ID but all active task IDs and per-task telemetry must be preserved. Technical success is not approval and does not auto-clear slow.

note: Seven Drive instructions re-verified after restoring the compact slow-table UI. Full one-scene-to-many-attempt telemetry remains internal; owner-facing UI has no attempt counters/expanders. Topview table CSS matches the pre-attempt baseline.

recovery_sync.note: Daily deep audit runs inside hourly Recovery when due; Topview Scene Intake & Slow Watch remains separate.

service_files_ui.note: Seven instructions are shown vertically 1-7; project-data links are separate and are not additional instructions.

slow_table_ui.telemetry_rule: All repeated/parallel attempts remain preserved per exact Topview task ID internally; queue/ETA/status values are never merged across attempts.
slow_table_ui.canonical_slow_rule: slow_scenes contains each Scene ID once regardless of number of active attempts
slow_table_ui.ux_rule: Owner-facing slow table intentionally shows one compact current/primary snapshot per Scene ID with no counters or expandable attempt rows; original table proportions are preserved.
